meta.description: Pulls a leaf blade over its veins. The veins lie in the horizontal plane, the thickness of a vein is how far the blade reaches around it, and their height bends the blade. The leaf is placed like the one of the leaf node: it grows along -z from its base and faces up, so it goes into instance and instance_from_points

veins.description: The veins, for example a stem turned flat with rotate, and branch_from_points on the points of points_on_path. The paths without a parent among them start at the base of the leaf.

size.description: At 1, a vein 1 m long makes a leaf as long as the one of the leaf node.

smooth.description: How far the blade fills in between the veins. 0 leaves a lobe or a tooth at every vein, more makes the margin entire.

margin.description: How far the margin is cut in, as a share of how far the blade reaches around the veins there, so a thin lobe gets small teeth. 1 cuts in to the vein. Read with alpha going along the margin from the base (0) to the tip (1) on both sides: a wave cuts teeth, a curve of alpha keeps them off the base. Negative values push the margin out.

relief.description: How deep the veins lie in the blade, negative values raise them.

resolution.description: Cells across the longer side of the leaf, for the grid that finds the margin. The mesh follows it: its edges are about 2.5 cells long along the margin and at the ends of the veins and grow to 8 cells in the middle of the blade.

color.description: The color of the blade, from mix_color, read at every vertex like set_color reads it on a leaf: alpha from the base to the tip, alpha across from the midrib to the margin, and alpha vein from 0 on the nearest vein to 1 at the edge of its groove, with path_info of that vein. A curve of alpha vein into the factor of a mix_color draws the veins, path_info depth tells the midrib from the side veins. Unconnected, the blade keeps the viewer's material.
